Compact Tractor Performance with Premium Comfort

Built for Work. Engineered for Everyday Productivity.

The KIOTI DK4220SEHCB combines diesel power, hydrostatic ease of use, and enclosed cab comfort into a dependable compact tractor platform. Designed for loader work, grading, mowing, material handling, brush clearing, and property maintenance, it provides excellent visibility, hydraulic capability, and operator comfort for long workdays.

Features May Include:

Enclosed Cab with HVAC

Factory cab provides heating and air conditioning for improved comfort during hot summers, cold weather, dust, and rain.

KIOTI 3-Cylinder Diesel Engine

Liquid-cooled diesel engine delivers dependable torque, fuel efficiency, and strong performance for demanding work applications.

Hydrostatic Transmission (HST)

Three-range hydrostatic transmission offers smooth, clutch-free operation and precise speed control for loader work and maneuvering.

Independent PTO System

Independent PTO with rear and mid PTO capability supports mowing, tilling, snow equipment, and additional attachments.

Category 1 Three-Point Hitch

Heavy-duty rear hitch supports a wide range of agricultural and property maintenance implements.

Hydraulic Loader Compatibility

Loader-ready design supports front-end loader applications for dirt, gravel, hay, brush, and material handling.

Deluxe Suspension Seat

Premium suspension seat improves operator comfort and reduces fatigue during long work sessions.

Hydrostatic Power Steering

Responsive steering system improves maneuverability and ease of operation in tight working environments.

Wet Disc Brakes

Durable wet disc braking system improves reliability and stopping performance.

Easy Service Access

One-piece hood and centralized service points simplify maintenance and inspections.

General

  • Manufacturer: KIOTI

Hydraulics
